name: Andrew Sigil
notes: Name confirmed as printed on the poster; not listed on the official Peninsula web page (the site lists Qses, who does not appear on the final poster).

name: Angular Momentum
descriptions: Textured grooves, polyrhythms and hypnotic, techno-tinged ambient soundscapes in a curated late-night DJ set.
notes: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site lists a DJ set.

name: Balancé
descriptions: Pedro Monteiro (Portugal), crafting psychedelic chillout since 2007; emotional soundscapes exploring rhythm, movement and balance.

name: Daniel Sol
descriptions: Madrid music lover and co-founder of Ensancha el Alma Records (psychill/downtempo); emotional journeys through jazz, soul, world and electronica textures.
Madrid music lover and co-founder of Ensancha el Alma Records (psychill/downtempo); emotional journeys through jazz, soul, world and electronica textures.

name: David Maurette ft. Irina Mikhailova
descriptions: Live collaboration blending ancient-inspired vocals, live percussion and high-energy electronics — Kaya Project vocalist Irina Mikhailova with DJ/percussionist David Maurette (Glastonbury, Boom).
notes: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site describes this as a live set.

name: Dezoncondor
descriptions: Deep psychedelic ambience, immersive drones and slow-moving sonic environments — cinematic psyambient storytelling designed for presence and mental expansion.

name: Etnica in Dub
descriptions: The Goa-defining Italian project reveals its dub dimension: spacious basslines, hypnotic echoes and downtempo grooves where classic psychedelia slows into warm fluidity.

name: Federico Baltimore
descriptions: Dado's (Transwave/Deedrah/Synthetic) chillout alter ego since 'Beleza!' (2007); emotional, cinematic downtempo blending ambient, lounge and classical influences.
notes: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site lists a DJ set.

name: Fishimself
descriptions: Haris P. (Athens), IT venue founder, Freeze Magazine alumnus and Ultimae/Matsuri compiler; long-form journeys through hypnotic techno, ambience and experimental electronics.

name: Floating Machine
descriptions: António Lourenço (Portugal), from jazz/funk/reggae roots to techno and ambient experimentation; adventurous, unpredictable aural journeys (Boom, Modem, ZNA).

name: Gagarin
descriptions: Founder of psybient.org; long, mind-expanding sets moving from midtempo ethnic textures to trippy, high-energy dance, inspired by conscious living.
notes: Poster name: Gagarin; full official name: Gagarin Project.

name: GoAstral
descriptions: Brazilian project (Ovnimoon Rec) of deep psychedelic storytelling and hypnotic layers, moving between cosmic intensity and spiritual elevation.
notes: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.

name: GUMI
descriptions: Maor Hasbani (Tel Aviv, also Skizologic); elastic downtempo fusing bold basslines, tribal rhythms and ethnic melodies with analog warmth (Boom, Rainbow Serpent).

name: Henriq
descriptions: Half of Zen Baboon and a Boom Festival music curator; cosmic border-free journeys from a producer with releases across many labels.

name: Holeg Spies
descriptions: French composer and sonic explorer (film scoring, musique concrète); a deep journey through his album 'Brave New World' — ambient passages and cinematic psychedelia.
notes: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site lists a DJ set.

name: Indra
descriptions: Croatian DJane and Ecstatic Dance Croatia founder; floating mystical atmospheres, deep dub bass and ethnic organic elements in story-driven sets (Boom, MoDem, Psy-Fi).

name: Irina Mikhailova
descriptions: Internationally touring vocalist (Kaya Project) whose voice appears across many artists' records and soundtracks — an entrancing solo live set of song and electronics.
notes: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site describes this as a live set.

name: Jonas
descriptions: Trashlords co-founder (Stoneage, Sweden) with 30+ years behind the decks; ambassador of the weird 'forest' corner of 90s psychedelia, unleashing its very essence.

name: Kala Hari
descriptions: Hélder José Martins' downtempo/dubby psychill project, moving toward organic downtempo and soft conscious dance journeys.

name: Kukan dub Lagan
descriptions: Itay's groovy fusion of dub, world music, downtempo and funk — warm, bass-heavy, soulful music made to put smiles on faces.

name: Ludvig & Stelar
descriptions: Downtempo duo inspired by Beethoven, Bach and Mozart (releases on Café del Mar); classical emotion meets cinematic downtempo psychedelia.

name: Man With No Name
descriptions: Martin Freeland (Perfecto), master of pure euphoria; timeless classics and rare private-archive gems in a set crafted especially for the Retro-Futuristic Celebration.

name: Max Lanfranconi
descriptions: The Etnica/Pleiadians/Crop Circles legend in a rare intimate setting — epic ZambuTemple energy scaled to the Welcome Party.
notes: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.

name: Mike Stellar
descriptions: Angolan-born refined selector rescuing rare gems into progressive folktronic downtempo — European electronics meeting African and Brazilian beats.

name: Mixmaster Morris
descriptions: Chillout pioneer shaping ambient/downtempo since the 1980s as The Irresistible Force; legendarily eclectic, cosmic, genre-transcending sets.

name: M.O.S.
descriptions: Mittelstandskinder Ohne Strom (Germany) — studio-engineering masters delivering a retrospective through M.O.S., Nerve and N.D.M.A., from signature grooves to euphoric 90s Goa in their 'Lunar Church' night session.

name: Nervasystem
descriptions: Drezz's cult mid-90s project (Matsuri, Suntrip, Zion 604); layered, hypnotic, experimental Goa built for inner journeys — and still evolving today.

name: Oliver Jones
descriptions: One half of Reefer Decree; a warm, hypnotic downtempo session of flowing grooves, rich ambient layers and time-dissolving psychedelic storytelling.

name: Ololiuqui
descriptions: Volker König's legendary Spirit Zone project in his Retro-Futuristic premiere; a ride designed to carry the floor from progressive grooves into raw Aussie-style psychedelia.

name: One Man Game vs Mystica
descriptions: Avi Pe'er and Yossef Master reunite on stage after 30 years, spanning One Man Game and its evolution Mystica; rolling basslines and uplifting afternoon melodies.

name: Organica
descriptions: Obsessive record digger exploring the underground since 1997; hypnotic basslines, tribal rhythms and elevated melodic atmospheres honouring old-school Goa roots.

name: OTT
descriptions: Legendary dub-electronics producer/engineer (worked with Brian Eno, The Orb, Youth); creator of 'Hallucinogen in Dub', 'Blumenkraft' and 'Skylon' — closing the Peninsula.

name: Process
descriptions: Sean Williams (Flying Rhino), pioneer behind Process and Satori; a night journey through 'One Drop or Two', 'Superior Technology' and classics made with Posford, Monro, Tristan and Tsuyoshi.

name: Process vs Aether
descriptions: Sean Williams (Process) back-to-back with Aether — official description still to be announced.
notes: Poster subtitle: Producer Set; the official site lists this as a DJ set.

name: Psychaos
descriptions: Joti Sidhu's harder alias, rooted in the Blue Room / Atomic Records era; an intense deep-hours producer set of industrial pressure, intricate layers and unexpected melody.

name: Saafi Brothers
descriptions: 30 years of psydub since 'Mystic Cigarettes' on Blue Room; a special set honouring their late brother-in-sound Michael Kohlbecker, from their debut to 'A Relaxed Blur'.

name: Sérgio Walgood
descriptions: Composer, live artist and host/curator of The Peninsula stage; immersive sonic storytelling bridging psychedelic downtempo, ritual ambience and deep hypnotic groove.

name: Shahar
descriptions: Aleph Zero co-founder and Shamanic Tales label head, famous for marathon 6–12-hour sets; three decades of curation woven into a slow, hypnotic psychedelic immersion.

name: Sharon
descriptions: Sharon Haiat (StoneAge Records, Israel), Goa-classics curator since 2017; fluid story-driven sets with seamless mixing — fresh from Goa Guardians 2022.
notes: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.

name: Synergy Dub
descriptions: Gabriel Le Mar and DJ Robin Triskele's DJ/live dub project (Liquid Sound Design), joined for ZNA 2026 by Groovetitan; future dub grooves with live overdubs.

name: Ubar Tmar
descriptions: Takeshi Isogai (Japan, Matsuri), the self-proclaimed 'freakiest Japanese on Earth'; experimental psychedelic labyrinths in which the dancer can never predict the next turn.

name: Virtuart
descriptions: French artist of the Suntrip family; immersive journeys and finely crafted melodies drawing on a rich 90s body of work.
notes: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.

name: Wacamolo
descriptions: Eric, spinning since mid-90s San Francisco; a worldwide patchwork of downtempo, dub, trip-hop and ethnic flavours from Goa to Bali.

name: X_T.i.g.m.a.
descriptions: Pedro Dias (Quest4Goa co-founder, long-time ZNA collaborator) opens the Welcome Party with an idiosyncratic, consciously curated genre-fluid session.
Pedro Dias, Quest4Goa co-founder (1999) and long-time ZNA collaborator; genre-fluid selections with a subtle experimental edge.
notes: Welcome Party — exclusive for shuttle/bus service guests.

name: Youth in Dub
descriptions: Martin Glover — Killing Joke bassist, Grammy-winning producer and founder of the Dragonfly and Liquid Sound Design labels — in deep dub mode.

name: Zen Baboon
descriptions: Daniel Rosado and Henrique Palhavã (live since Boom 2006); Portuguese downtempo royalty with releases on major underground labels.
